name: Duck and Cover [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your allies assist you in avoiding certain attacks.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally and both of you are required to make a Reflex saving throw against a spell or effect, your ally may take the result of your die roll or their own (your modifiers still apply to the roll, regardless of which result they take). If your ally takes your result, they are knocked prone (or staggered on their next turn, if they are already prone or cannot be knocked prone). In addition, your ally receives a +2 cover bonus to their AC against ranged attacks as long as you are wielding a shield.
